sameFrameResize.scope: Same OpenCV-decoded BGR frames; only downsampling changes. Center point emulates Android sampling coordinates but does not emulate device YUV decode/color conversion. Not an Android feature parity claim.

conclusions: Extra corrected-native miss is human rally16, 562.4958444444444 to568.7457444444444 seconds. Desktop-only miss is rally6,273.36562222222216 to281.11440000000005.
Replacing desktop audio alone swaps which rally is missed; it does not recover rally16.

Replacing focus/blur alone is sufficient to recover rally16 with the frozen decoder. Same-frame point vs area sampling reproduces the direction and magnitude of focus/blur drift. This is strong evidence of visual preprocessing mismatch, not a completed app repair.
A separate first-frame-after vs nearest-frame convention changes the selected PTS offset scalar; replacing that scalar recovers16 but introduces22, so it is not a qualified isolated fix.
